summary: Fix race condition in concurrent add operations by adding file locking to the storage layer
approach: Added exclusive_lock() context manager using fcntl.flock to provide mutual exclusion for load-modify-save operations
risks: fcntl is Unix-specific; this solution does not work on Windows
Lock file (.todo.json.lock) may be left behind if process crashes
limitations: Only the add() operation is protected; mark_done, mark_undone, remove operations could also benefit from locking
